Fit a densemlp Survival Model

Source: R/fit_densemlp.R
fit_densemlp.Rd

Fits a compact feedforward neural network for right-censored survival data with the densemlp package (native C++ backend, no torch dependency) and returns an object compatible with the mlsurv_model interface. The IPCW integrated-Brier loss (loss = "brier") is used by default so that a full survival-probability curve is available; predictions are interpolated from the network's discrete-time grid onto the requested evaluation times.

Usage

fit_densemlp(
  formula,
  data,
  loss = c("brier", "cox"),
  n_bins = 10,
  hidden_units = c(32, 16),
  epochs = 100,
  lr = 0.001,
  ...
)

Arguments

formula

A survival formula Surv(time, status) ~ predictors.

data

A data.frame containing the formula variables.

loss

Survival loss: "brier" (default, discrete-time hazard grid, required for survival-curve prediction) or "cox" (a single linear risk score only).

n_bins

Number of discrete-time bins for loss = "brier" (default 10).

hidden_units

Integer vector of hidden-layer widths (default c(32, 16)).

epochs

Maximum training epochs (default 100).

lr

Adam learning rate (default 1e-3).

...

Additional arguments passed to densemlp::densemlp() (for example batch_size, dropout, batch_norm, early_stopping, patience, ensemble, seed, ncores).

Value

An object of class "mlsurv_model" with elements model, learner ("densemlp"), formula, data, time, status, and loss.

See also

predict_densemlp, densemlp, fit for the verb interface

Examples

mod <- fit_densemlp(Surv(time, status) ~ age + karno + celltype, veteran,
                    n_bins = 8, epochs = 20, hidden_units = c(16, 8))
summary(mod)
#> 
#> ── densemlp summary ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> Formula:
#> Surv(time, status) ~ age + karno + celltype
#> Engine: densemlp
#> Learner: densemlp
#> Data summary:
#> - Observations: 137
#> - Predictors: "age, karno, celltypesmallcell, celltypeadeno, celltypelarge"
#> - Time range: [1, 999]
#> - Event rate: "93.4%"
